rows.grounds: present participle describing the goddess's radiance
first member of compound describing origin or abode
second member indicating association with the lotus

items.question: What visual attributes characterize the goddess in her prescribed meditation?
premises: The goddess is visualized as illuminating the world.
The goddess is described as lotus-going or lotus-born.
items.inference: The meditation presents the goddess as a radiant being associated with the lotus who illumines the world.
uncertainties: The exact sense of saroja-gām (lotus-born, lotus-dwelling, or lotus-going) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: She is to be meditated upon as illuminating the world and associated with the lotus.
